summary.text: Jereme Peters, a Libertarian Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Arizona's 6th Congressional District to JoAnna Mendoza, receiving 1.3% of the vote to Mendoza's 52.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
He advanced from the Libertarian primary on July 21, 2026.
No biography or platform for him was found in the sources reviewed.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona, 2026
